title: Part Sale notes: notified like any note, no Customer Visible, Part Sales View
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B (e.g. "Dana Lee"); they are listed under Settings -> Staff.
  3. A part sale at this location: Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer.
  4. To write a note on any of these records: on its Notes tab click New Note, type the message, type @ and pick the person, then save.
  5. A second teammate, User C (e.g. "Sam Ortiz"). Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; leave Work Orders -> View ticked and untick Part Sales -> View; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User C -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" -> save. User C must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  6. As User A, write a note on the part sale that @-mentions User C (before switching to User C).
custom_steps:
1. As User A, write a note on the part sale that @-mentions User B; check User B's Inbox and email.
  2. On the part sale's New Note dialog, look for a "Customer Visible" checkbox.
  3. Sign in as User C. Try to open the part sale and add a note; then open the Inbox and look for the part sale note that mentioned you.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • User B is notified of the part sale note in the Inbox and by email, like any other note.
  • The part sale New Note dialog has no "Customer Visible" checkbox.
  • User C, who has Work Orders -> View but not Part Sales -> View, cannot add a part sale note and does not see part sale notes in the Inbox: Work Orders -> View alone is not enough.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10252 (S9, Notes on Part Sales); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S9; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “A user who can see a Part Sale note is notified of it in the inbox and by email like any other note.”
  • S9-N1: “A Part Sale note does not offer the "Customer Visible" checkbox; Part Sale notes are internal to the shop.”
  • S9-N2: “A user without 'Part Sales → View' cannot add a Part Sale note and does not see Part Sale notes in the inbox. 'Work Orders → View' alone is not enough: part sale notes follow Part Sales permissions.”
